documents.title: COURTESY POLICY
documents.text:
COURTESY POLICY
No smoking within and around the Mall except in the two designated smoking areas
No drinking for persons under the age of 18 in the Food Zone and other common areas. Management reserves the right to ask for an Identification Card.
We like your pets too! Please ensure leash always! Pick up their pressies!
No hawking/soliciting for any kind of business.
All vehicles are parked at the owner’s risk. The Management Shall not take liability for any loss or damage.
There will be mandatory security checks for all persons and/or vehicles entering into the mall
No photography or videography allowed within and around the premises without express permission from the Management.
Management reserves the right of admission into the premises.

documents.title: Directions
documents.text:
Directions
Galleria Shopping Mall is conveniently located in Karen, Nairobi, at the junction of Lang’ata and Magadi Roads.
Find directions for travelling by car, taxi, bus or matatu below.
View Directions on Google Maps!
Grab a cab to Galleria
Open your Uber, Bolt or Little Cab app and input the destination as Galleria Mall, Karen (You can click the button below to copy the full name).
Request an Uber online
Open Uber App
Request a Bolt online
Open Bolt App
Open Little Cab App
Directions to Galleria via bus or matatu
From Town/Langata
Take a bus or matatu route 24 to Karen or 125/126 to Rongai/Kiserian. Ask to alight at Galleria, Matatus to Rongai and Kiserian will drop you next to the Magadi Road entrance and the ones to Karen will drop you at the Langata road entrance.
From Karen
Take a bus or matatu route 24 to town, ask to alight at Galleria. You will be dropped at the Langata road entrance.
From Rongai/Kiserian
Take a bus or matatu route 125/126 to town. Ask to alight at Galleria. You will be dropped off near the Magadi Road entrance.
From Ngong
Take a bus or matatu from Ngong to Town. Alight at Karen. Across Karen Crossroads, there is stage, take a bus route 24 to town or Bomas. Ask to alight at Galleria, you will be dropped off near the Langata road entrance.

How to pay for Parking
Ample and secure parking is available across Galleria, including outdoor parking and a shaded parking silo that has direct access to the New Wing from both levels.

Park-N-Go, is reckoned as the global market leader in access management and security solutions and visitor management, offering a broad range of innovative, customized systems enabling swift and secure access management of people and vehicles.
For enquiries or further details please contact Park N Go.

About Artcaffe
Artcaffé is a full-service and on-the-move bakery, coffee shop, bar, and restaurant for all ages. They offer freshly prepared, high-quality and simply delicious food consistently in a relaxed yet sophisticated setting. From a quick Grab & Go or a morning meeting as you beat the traffic, to a coffee catch up or long lunch with friends; from meeting up for Happy Hour with colleagues or enjoying a delicious date-night dinner – they are versatile and welcoming to all…here for you every day, and every step of the way!
They bake fresh, artisanal bread and pastries; brew real, rich Kenyan coffee; craft signature cocktails and they lead the way in modern casual dining in Kenya.
Even more than good food and great people, Artcaffé is about the atmosphere. Nairobi is vibrant and diverse, and the Artcaffé restaurant has a unique design and distinct style. You know you are in the heart of the city and the hub of East Africa when visiting Artcaffé.

About Lintons Beauty World
Lintons is a leading beauty brand in East Africa, founded in 2008 by Dr Joyce Gikunda and Edward Gikunda. Lintons is on a mission to impact the lives of Africans through beauty. Currently, Lintons executes this mission through these 4 focus areas; Lintons Beauty World, a multichannel retail business that has grown to 30 shops in Nairobi, Mombasa & Kampala offering top of the line skincare, color cosmetics, luxury fragrance and day-spa experience. Through these shops, Lintons not only houses global brands such as Estee Lauder, Clinique, MAC, Clarins, Lancome, Chanel, Dior, but also offers a platform to upcoming local brands and manufacturers to reach a fast growing consumer base.
Customers are increasingly able to access Lintons’ wide range of products via digital channels such as Lintons ECP and Jumia.
Purpose
Lintons envisions a future where Africans are fully awakened to their inner beauty and use this to fearlessly transform the world around them. In this future, “Beauty” is not just a feel good notion, but a high-impact highly-sought-after career pathway, a value chain uplifting many out of poverty and a catalyst stirring growth of local media, agribusiness, manufacturing & services.
Values
Lintons is motivated by 3 core values that are foundational to our culture, brand & business:
Passion: we love what we do and put our customer’s needs first.
Authenticity: we understand trust is earned by offering only legitimate, non-counterfeit products & services, over decades.Innovation: we continuously learn from our customers and partners, and solve problems in new ways

About Nairobi Hospital
Please note: In case the phone lines for the Galleria Nairobi Hospital branch are down, kindly reach them on 0719 155 496.
Opened in 1954, The Nairobi Hospital has excelled in medical expertise and services provision and has deservedly earned recognition throughout East Africa and beyond as an advanced diagnostic, treatment and referral centre. Expansive investment in the latest technology and medical equipment has enabled us to establish leadership in medical procedures both in Kenya and outside.
We take pride in our highly qualified professionals who deliver our mission every day, translating their knowledge and expertise to internationally compliant practices in healthcare provision. Courtesy, consideration and unreserved respect towards our patients’ privacy, dignity and confidentiality have time and again helped us earn their trust and goodwill. Our dedicated nursing staff provides professional care within a friendly and comfortable environment, ensuring that being in the hospital is a more pleasurable and less anxious time for our patients and their families.

About Star Optics
Our Goal is to have 100% customer satisfaction, first time, every time.
This means that we endeavor to give you the highest quality services at the best value for money. Yes, our dream is not to to be the largest optical store – it is to be the best at providing optical care.
It’s our mission to help you find the perfect-for-you pair of eyewear as well as care for the eyes behind them. And if you don’t need spectacles, we’ll tell you.
An optical store is about more than selling spectacles, and we pride ourselves in doing our best to take real care of your eyes. For over 15 years, we’ve been working to make sure that we keep our clientele first making us one of the most trusted brands by insurance companies.
We’ve put together a team of some of the best people – and all from Kenya. With a combined experience of over 100 years both locally and abroad, our optometrists are trained to pick up various diseases of the eyes. We’re one of the few optometrists locally who’ve even picked up life threatening conditions such as pituitary tumors during our comprehensive eye examinations.
At Star Optics, your eyes are in good hands.

About Stone Arts
Stone Arts could be traced to ancient civilizations of Rome, India as well as Athens in Greece where they made historical statements that couldn’t really be matched.

Stone arts specialize in Granite, Marble, Custom made Gazebos of sized 2m diameter to 10m diameter, indoor and outdoor fountains, building facades, feature walls, murals, fireplaces, statues and much more.
Stone Arts follow no political boundaries in case of execution and art.

About Text Book Center
Text Book Centre Ltd is an educational and office supplies conglomerate .The firms core activity is supply of education, general books and educational material, including stationery supplies to professionals, schools, colleges, universities, international organizations and non-government and government organizations countrywide and to buyers in Uganda, Sudan, Somalia, Malawi, Zanzibar and Tanzania.
In recent years TBC has diversified into PCs, computer’s – desktops, printers, scanners, photocopiers, paper – shredders and other office equipment and supplies.
TBC are the Kenyan dealers and distributors for Rexel staplers, shredders, over-head projectors, Bantex box files, Staedtler pencils, Faber Castell technical instruments, Pidilite, Camlin, Windsor & Newton and Marie’s art materials, Oxford Mathematical sets from Helix, Omega office and technical instruments. In addition, TBC is the exclusive distributor for Pelikan and Geha Products in Kenya. The most recent addition to the product portfolio is the”MORE” range of school and office stationery.
Text Book Centre Ltd has a renewed focus on all our Customers and Customer Service which plays an important part in all our transactions. Training of our staff is an important factor in this.

1934 Rolls Royce Boatail + Bikes display
25th September 2024
Events
On the 21st and 22nd of September, Galleria was the place to be, with an iconic 1934 Rolls Royce Boat Tail taking centre stage. Its flawless yellow exterior, intricate wooden boat tail, and gleaming chrome accents captivated everyone who passed by. It truly was a show-stopper—you couldn’t help but snap a picture (or two)!
But that wasn’t all! Alongside this masterpiece, we also had an impressive lineup of powerful motorbikes that left bike lovers in awe. 🏍️ The blend of classic elegance and raw power made it a weekend spectacle no one will soon forget!
Stay tuned for more exciting events at Galleria!

documents.title: A Powerful Tribute for Women’s Day at Galleria! 💜
documents.text:
A Powerful Tribute for Women’s Day at Galleria! 💜
10th March 2025
Events
Still Craft Events brought three legendary women to life, portrayed in striking living statues:
🌿 Wangari Maathai – “When women plant change, the world blossoms.”
A tribute to environmental activism and female leadership, honouring Wangari Maathai’s legacy of nurturing growth and transformation.
🏃🏽‍♀️ Catherine Ndereba – “Stride by stride, women lead the way.”
A symbol of perseverance and greatness, proving that women break barriers, defy odds, and lead the way.
🗽 Statue of Liberty – “Liberty for women isn’t a gift—it’s a right!”
A bold statement on freedom and equality, reminding us that women’s rights should never be a privilege.
This was more than just a showcase—it was a movement of empowerment, reflection, and celebration. Thank you to everyone who joined us in witnessing the art, feeling the empowerment, and honouring the phenomenal women who shape our world.

The African Cultural Choir performance on Easter Sunday was amazing! The energy, the music – everything was just awesome!

Classics like “Jambo” echoed through the halls, filling the air with joy and celebration. But it was their renditions of African songs, specially curated for the occasion, that truly stole the show. Each note, each harmony, was a testament to their rich cultural heritage and the spirit of Easter. It was more than a performance; it was an experience of unity, rhythm, and soul. Build the ultimate Subz Sandwich
2nd August 2024
Store Feature
Imagine the perfect bite—every layer bursting with flavour and texture. Here’s your chance to create your dream sandwich. What will you choose?
Step 1: Pick your Base
For protein lovers, choose from Pepperoni, Salami, Turkey breast, BBQ beef, Teriyaki chicken, Peri-peri chicken, Tuna, or Roast beef. Prefer a veggie delight? Go for Falafel, Halloumi, or Paneer.
Step 2: Fresh and Crunchy Toppings
Layer your sandwich with fresh Cucumber, Green peppers, Tomatoes, Red onions, Lettuce, Corn, Spinach, Pickles, Olives, chilli, and Jalapenos—add as much or as little as you like!
Step 3: Sauce it Up
Choose from their delicious sauces: Chipotle, Yellow mustard, Honey mustard, Sweet chilli, Hot chilli, Mayo, BBQ sauce, Ketchup, or a simple touch of Olive oil. The perfect sauce can transform your sub!
Step 4: Bread and Final Touch
Select your favourite bread—Italian, Hearty Italian, 9-grain, Honey oat, or Parmesan oregano. To finish, decide: cheese or no cheese? Toasted or not toasted?

This Christmas, Galleria transformed into a holiday wonderland with twinkling lights, grand trees, and cascading fairy lights creating a magical atmosphere.
Chrome orbs reflected the festive glow, while snow-like décor added a dreamy winter charm. With golden lights and shimmering accents, every corner felt like Christmas—perfect for those magical holiday moments! 🎄✨

Events Videos
On May 10th – 11th, we celebrated mums in the most heartfelt way this Mother’s Day. 💐
From lush floral setups to soulful music and pampering experiences, every moment was designed to say thank you, Mum. Here’s a look back at all the weekend highlights:
🌷 The Floral Photo Booth
Our atrium was transformed into a blooming garden by Chic Luxury Events — the perfect setting for sweet family photos and keepsake memories. Shoppers posed, laughed, and got their photo taken with branded mementoes sent them as a keepsake.

💅 Complimentary Manicures
Extreme Styling Studio treated mums to mini makeovers with free manicures at our special pop-up Nail Bar. A little pampering goes a long way!

Friday, 10 May: Andy Afriq set the tone with smooth saxophone vibes that echoed through the mall.

A lovely addition to the weekend — Greenit had a curated selection of flowers and plants perfect for gifting or adding a little green to your space.
‹›
We’re grateful to everyone who joined us in celebrating the incredible women who do it all. Thank you for making it a weekend to remember. ❤️

documents.title: How to pay for parking through M-Pesa
documents.text:
How to pay for parking through M-Pesa
28th September 2023
Mall Feature
Did you know you can pay for your parking via Mpesa?
1. Scan the QR code on your ticket using your phone camera.
2. It will open the link which will show your bill, confirm your bill and press the Mpesa button.
3. Input and confirm your phone number
4. It will open Mpesa on your phone asking you to input your Mpesa password. Key in your password and your ticket is paid. safari njema.
Swipe to see our current parking fees.

On the 21st & 22nd of December 2024, the African Cultural Choir brought Galleria to life with a performance that was equal parts soulful and electrifying. From the opening beats with tunes like ‘Jambo Bwana’ and their signature entrance and exit music, they had the crowd hooked, turning the atrium into a dance floor with their energetic take on ‘Ding Dong Merrily on High’ among others.
Their Africanised rendition of ‘Joy to the World’ was a beautiful fusion of African rhythm and Christmas spirit, while their powerful vocals on ‘Hosanna’ gave us the chills. The ladies got to serenade diner at Java, while the gentlemen kept shoppers at the atrium entertained.
With every note, every harmony, and every dance step, they filled the mall with joy, ending on the same high energy they started with—an unforgettable holiday moment!

documents.title: The Lion King Screening – 24th August 2024
documents.text:
The Lion King Screening – 24th August 2024
25th August 2024
Events Kids
On 24th August 2024, Galleria was transformed into a vibrant jungle, thanks to the incredible décor by Chic Luxury Events. From the moment guests stepped in, they were immersed in the world of The Lion King, feeling like they were right there in the heart of the savannah.
The atmosphere was electric as multitudes gathered to relive the magic of The Lion King, Both the 1994 classic and the stunning 2019 remake. With each guest receiving a set of headphones, the shared experience became wonderfully personal, allowing everyone to connect deeply with the story. It was heartwarming to see the little ones’ faces light up as they experienced the timeless charm and magic of the original film, some for the first time.
Later on, at 3 PM, the audience was treated to the breathtaking visuals and powerful storytelling of the 2019 remake. The stunning animation and fresh take on the beloved story left everyone in awe, making it a truly unforgettable cinematic experience for all ages.
The Lion King screenings at Galleria were more than just a movie event—they were a journey into the heart of a classic tale that continues to captivate audiences, generation after generation.

documents.title: Celebrating Classic Car Elegance
documents.text:
Celebrating Classic Car Elegance
25th September 2024
Events
Over the years, Galleria has been a proud host to an array of stunning vintage and classic cars that tell a story of elegance and automotive history.
In September 2022, we showcased the timeless 1936 Rolls Royce KHK570 and the charming 1930 Ford Box Body T561. Fast forward to Father’s Day weekend in 2023, where we featured an exclusive exhibition courtesy of the John Wroe Vintage Car Collection, including the award-winning 1930 Ford Model A Turdor F1190 and the magnificent 1936/7 Bentley Tourer KBW 248.
This year, in September 2024, we were thrilled to present the breathtaking 1934 Rolls Royce Boat Tail. ✨
Don’t miss your chance to experience several classic and vintage masterpieces! Get your tickets for this year’s Concours D’Elegance at https://concourskenya.com/ and get to witness this prestigious event!

documents.title: Chapter & Chill: Who Moved My Cheese?
documents.text:
Chapter & Chill: Who Moved My Cheese?
12th September 2026
Events
Chapter & Chill brought readers together for an interactive afternoon of conversation, reflection and plenty of laughs.
Hosted with Passportz and Pagez, the session explored Who Moved My Cheese?, with Joanne Mwangi Muthoni guiding the group through conversations around change, choices and how we respond when life moves our “cheese”.
It was thoughtful without being heavy, with lots of participation and plenty to take away beyond the afternoon.
Thank you to everyone who joined us. We hope to see you at the next Chapter & Chill.

chunks.text: Parking Parking Fees How to pay for Parking Ample and secure parking is available across Galleria, including outdoor parking and a shaded parking silo that has direct access to the New Wing from both levels. Parking facilitated by Park-N-Go Park-N-Go, is reckoned as the global market leader in access management and security solutions and visitor management, offering a broad range of innovative, customized systems enabling swift and secure access management of people and vehicles. Please contact the store to confirm the latest opening hours. About Lintons Beauty World Lintons is a leading beauty brand in East Africa, founded in 2008 by Dr Joyce Gikunda and Edward Gikunda. Lintons is on a mission to impact the lives of Africans through beauty. Currently, Lintons executes this mission through these 4 focus areas; Lintons Beauty World, a multichannel retail business that has grown to 30 shops in Nairobi, Mombasa & Kampala offering top of the line skincare, color cosmetics, luxury fragrance and day-spa experience. Through these shops, Lintons not only houses global brands such as Estee Lauder, Clinique, MAC, Clarins, Lancome, Chanel, Dior, but also offers a platform to upcoming local brands and manufacturers to reach a fast growing consumer base. Customers are increasingly able to access Lintons’ wide range of products via digital channels such as Lintons ECP and Jumia. Purpose Lintons envisions a future where Africans are fully awakened to their inner beauty and use this to fearlessly transform the world around them. In this future, “Beauty” is not just a feel good notion, but a high-impact highly-sought-after career pathway, a value chain uplifting many out of poverty and a catalyst stirring growth of local media, agribusiness, manufacturing & services. Values Lintons is motivated by 3 core values that are foundational to our culture, brand & business: Passion: we love what we do and put our customer’s needs first. chunks.title: A Powerful Tribute for Women’s Day at Galleria! 💜
chunks.text: A Powerful Tribute for Women’s Day at Galleria! 💜 10th March 2025 Events Still Craft Events brought three legendary women to life, portrayed in striking living statues: 🌿 Wangari Maathai – “When women plant change, the world blossoms.” A tribute to environmental activism and female leadership, honouring Wangari Maathai’s legacy of nurturing growth and transformation. 🏃🏽‍♀️ Catherine Ndereba – “Stride by stride, women lead the way.” A symbol of perseverance and greatness, proving that women break barriers, defy odds, and lead the way. 🗽 Statue of Liberty – “Liberty for women isn’t a gift—it’s a right!” A bold statement on freedom and equality, reminding us that women’s rights should never be a privilege. This was more than just a showcase—it was a movement of empowerment, reflection, and celebration. Thank you to everyone who joined us in witnessing the art, feeling the empowerment, and honouring the phenomenal women who shape our world. chunks.title: Build the ultimate Subz Sandwich
chunks.text: Build the ultimate Subz Sandwich 2nd August 2024 Store Feature Imagine the perfect bite—every layer bursting with flavour and texture. Here’s your chance to create your dream sandwich. What will you choose? Step 1: Pick your Base For protein lovers, choose from Pepperoni, Salami, Turkey breast, BBQ beef, Teriyaki chicken, Peri-peri chicken, Tuna, or Roast beef. Prefer a veggie delight? Go for Falafel, Halloumi, or Paneer. Step 2: Fresh and Crunchy Toppings Layer your sandwich with fresh Cucumber, Green peppers, Tomatoes, Red onions, Lettuce, Corn, Spinach, Pickles, Olives, chilli, and Jalapenos—add as much or as little as you like! Step 3: Sauce it Up Choose from their delicious sauces: Chipotle, Yellow mustard, Honey mustard, Sweet chilli, Hot chilli, Mayo, BBQ sauce, Ketchup, or a simple touch of Olive oil. The perfect sauce can transform your sub! Step 4: Bread and Final Touch Select your favourite bread—Italian, Hearty Italian, 9-grain, Honey oat, or Parmesan oregano. To finish, decide: cheese or no cheese? Toasted or not toasted? chunks.title: How to pay for parking through M-Pesa
chunks.text: How to pay for parking through M-Pesa 28th September 2023 Mall Feature Did you know you can pay for your parking via Mpesa? 1. Scan the QR code on your ticket using your phone camera. 2. It will open the link which will show your bill, confirm your bill and press the Mpesa button. 3. Input and confirm your phone number 4. It will open Mpesa on your phone asking you to input your Mpesa password. Key in your password and your ticket is paid. safari njema. Swipe to see our current parking fees. From the opening beats with tunes like ‘Jambo Bwana’ and their signature entrance and exit music, they had the crowd hooked, turning the atrium into a dance floor with their energetic take on ‘Ding Dong Merrily on High’ among others. Their Africanised rendition of ‘Joy to the World’ was a beautiful fusion of African rhythm and Christmas spirit, while their powerful vocals on ‘Hosanna’ gave us the chills. The ladies got to serenade diner at Java, while the gentlemen kept shoppers at the atrium entertained. With every note, every harmony, and every dance step, they filled the mall with joy, ending on the same high energy they started with—an unforgettable holiday moment! August at Galleria was packed with fun, creativity, and endless smiles, making it a fantastic way to keep the little ones entertained during the holidays! Puppets254 brought storytelling to life, along with exciting activities that kept kids engaged all month long. Here’s a look back at the magic! × 🎭 3rd August – Puppets, Paint & Play! The month kicked off with an enchanting puppet show that had kids completely captivated! Puppets254 wowed the audience with their creative storytelling, lively puppets, and interactive moments. Adding to the fun, little ones got their faces painted in vibrant designs and enjoyed playful meet-and-greets with adorable mascots—a truly magical afternoon! 🎨 31st August – Arts, Crafts & More! To wrap up the month, we switched things up with a hands-on arts and crafts session where kids let their creativity shine. Alongside face painting and more mascot fun, it was a colourful and engaging way to end the holidays on a high note! From painting to playful hugs with our friendly Panda Mascot 🐼, every moment was filled with joy. It was an unforgettable month of fun at Galleria, and we loved seeing the little ones light up with excitement! chunks.title: The Lion King Screening – 24th August 2024
chunks.text: The Lion King Screening – 24th August 2024 25th August 2024 Events Kids On 24th August 2024, Galleria was transformed into a vibrant jungle, thanks to the incredible décor by Chic Luxury Events. From the moment guests stepped in, they were immersed in the world of The Lion King, feeling like they were right there in the heart of the savannah. The atmosphere was electric as multitudes gathered to relive the magic of The Lion King, Both the 1994 classic and the stunning 2019 remake. With each guest receiving a set of headphones, the shared experience became wonderfully personal, allowing everyone to connect deeply with the story. It was heartwarming to see the little ones’ faces light up as they experienced the timeless charm and magic of the original film, some for the first time. Later on, at 3 PM, the audience was treated to the breathtaking visuals and powerful storytelling of the 2019 remake. The stunning animation and fresh take on the beloved story left everyone in awe, making it a truly unforgettable cinematic experience for all ages. The Lion King screenings at Galleria were more than just a movie event—they were a journey into the heart of a classic tale that continues to captivate audiences, generation after generation. chunks.title: Celebrating Classic Car Elegance
chunks.text: Celebrating Classic Car Elegance 25th September 2024 Events Over the years, Galleria has been a proud host to an array of stunning vintage and classic cars that tell a story of elegance and automotive history. In September 2022, we showcased the timeless 1936 Rolls Royce KHK570 and the charming 1930 Ford Box Body T561. Fast forward to Father’s Day weekend in 2023, where we featured an exclusive exhibition courtesy of the John Wroe Vintage Car Collection, including the award-winning 1930 Ford Model A Turdor F1190 and the magnificent 1936/7 Bentley Tourer KBW 248. This year, in September 2024, we were thrilled to present the breathtaking 1934 Rolls Royce Boat Tail. ✨ Don’t miss your chance to experience several classic and vintage masterpieces! Get your tickets for this year’s Concours D’Elegance at https://concourskenya.com/ and get to witness this prestigious event! chunks.text: Chapter & Chill: Who Moved My Cheese? 12th September 2026 Events Chapter & Chill brought readers together for an interactive afternoon of conversation, reflection and plenty of laughs. It was thoughtful without being heavy, with lots of participation and plenty to take away beyond the afternoon. Thank you to everyone who joined us. We hope to see you at the next Chapter & Chill.
